machine.type: close-coupled gas atomiser with Ar recirculation per the duty sheet and the AQS-MFG-010 tool row (Table 2.1, rev C metering split): atomization tower OD 300 (wall 6, study) with powder-collection pot, close-coupled gas ring (R 60, GMR 2.5 study) at the tower neck, heated tundish OD 160 on a stand over the tower (1 kW tundish duty), Ar recirculation loop (DN32) to the compressor envelope (30 bar class, A-M-177), control cabinet as a purchased envelope; hold-down frame is the guard (A-MACH practice)
machine.tool_row: AQS-MFG-010 Table 2.1: Close-coupled gas atomiser with Ar recirculation, nameplate 5.5 kW; energy basis Ar GMR 2.5 at 30 bar: 0.246 kWh/kg x 3.56 kg/d + tundish 1 kW x 1 h
machine.a177: A-M-177: GMR 2.5, 30 bar, compressor isothermal eta 0.6, 10 min pour, 1 kW tundish
machine.material: 316L where the stream is wet (duty section 3); the powder loop is dry - CA 0 mm shop practice; 316L carried for the melt-contact hardware

purchased.compressor: Ar recirculation compressor, 30 bar class (A-M-177); purchased per plan rule 6
purchased.cabinet: control cabinet (5.5 kW nameplate, AQS-MFG-010 Table 2.1); purchased per plan rule 6
purchased.tundish_heater: 1 kW tundish duty (AQS-MFG-010); purchased per plan rule 6

machine.pressure_class: the 30 bar Ar loop class is the A-M-177 study basis; no design_kPa is stated on the node and the relief case is pending (unit task 07) - the loop hardware is drawn as envelopes, no flange drawn (W4 110 % rule)
machine.guard: four-post hold-down/guard frame pins the registry box (X-PAR-04); 8 slab anchors (fasteners.csv)
machine.study_dims: tower, tundish, ring and pot dimensions are study values sized to the 3.56 kg/d class (WORK_ORDER W12)
